description: Syrian Arab Republic Airports is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Syria. This dataset contains Syrian Arab Republic Airports provided by the logistics cluster. Coverage: Syrian Arab Republic. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Syria. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
